subject: Quick note on Evolution Sheet Metal's website
bodyText:

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Evolution Sheet Metal stood out.

Bury / Ramsey sub-contract fabricators on Upwood Air Park - and evosml.co.uk/1615.html is still an old Favor template contact page with hasFlashNavigation wired in, while the address block still lists Fax: 01487 710674 beside Tel: 01487 711 028.
